text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Special Week managed to achieve splendid 
results in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Together, we made it through those truly 
precious "first three years"—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, one day while still basking in the 
afterglow of that major milestone.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
H-Helloooo... Traineeeer! Are you 
thereee!?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
H-Hello! Ehehe... Sorry for the sudden 
surprise.
choice_data_list: What on earth is the matter?
What on earth is the matter?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...Um. The truth is...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
—Would you like to take a trip to Hokkaido 
with me?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...In short, it seems she was asking me 
to come along for her visit home."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, sorry to startle you. I'm just a 
little nervous...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Still, thank you for coming!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"I'd been thinking about introducing you 
for a long time. Once I managed to get 
proper results in the Twinkle Series, that 
is."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
To my moms... in person. I want to tell 
them, "This is my Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
It's because Trainer was by my side that I 
was able to grow this much!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Swaying on the train alongside a shyly 
smiling Special Week, I looked forward to 
the fun journey ahead.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —...Or so it seemed, however.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Uh-oh. Huuhhh, wait, what, what, 
what...!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"‘I'll show you how much I've grown, 
Trainer!’ I ended up tagging along as she 
walked off with utter confidence, but..."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Wait, no no no!? C-come on, you're teasing 
me again~! I told you, I've grown taller!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"There's no way I'm lost... I made sure I 
took the right train, too..."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...I'm, I'm so soooorrrryyyy!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"At this rate, we're going to miss our 
flight! ...While I was in a total panic 
alongside Special Week—"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...H-Huh? A phone call?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Hellooo, Spe-chan? Are you about lost 
right now~?"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
S-Sei-chan!? How do you know about 
that...!?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
No, dear, you were already getting the 
train names wrong yesterday when you were 
checking the route out loud.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: No way, right!?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Spe-chan, you really are 
hopeless, aren't you!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Where are you right now? I'll look up the 
shortest route right away, so please stay 
calm and tell me."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, Grass-chan, El-chan... 
Everyoneee...!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I-I-I-I maaaade it in tiiime...!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Seriously...! Let's buy a mountain of 
souvenirs for everyone...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"...Plus, I'll have to add that to the 
list of things to report to Mom."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Telling me that there are lots of 
friends... and lots of rivals out there.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Because I got to compete with all of them 
at full strength, that's why I was able to 
grow strong!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: *deep breath*... *haaaah*.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah. It smells so nostalgic. It 
smells like my hometown..."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Heading straight home like this to greet 
Mom—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
After that, I'd like you to come with me 
to visit my other mother's grave, too. 
...Would that be all right?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...Um, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
For you, Trainer... who believed in my 
dream and supported me all the way from 
the beginning.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: How do I look to you right now?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I—am proud of who I am, too!
